name: Treasure Hunt
summary: Treasure Hunt is a memory-based puzzle game included as a bonus title on the Sega Genesis Ultimate Portable Game Player by AtGames. At the start of each level, the game briefly reveals a full map displaying the locations of hidden treasures alongside various deadly traps and hazards. Once the timer runs out, the dangers are hidden from view, and the player must rely entirely on their short-term memory to navigate the safe paths, avoid the invisible obstacles, and successfully collect all the treasure.
